stories.story_fr: Gains de part de marché dans les quatre activités au second semestre.
stories.story_en: Market share gains across all four businesses in the second half.
stories.quote: Sonova achieves market share gains across all businesses and announces upcoming CEO transition

stories.story_fr: Transition du CEO avec le départ d'Arnd Kaldowski et l'arrivée d'Eric Bernard.
stories.story_en: CEO transition with Arnd Kaldowski stepping down and Eric Bernard taking over.
stories.quote: Arnd Kaldowski will step down as CEO effective September 30, 2025... Eric Bernard... will assume full responsibilities as CEO by October 1, 2025.

stories.story_fr: Lancement des plateformes Phonak Infinio et Sphere Infinio.
stories.story_en: Launch of Phonak Infinio and Sphere Infinio platforms.
stories.quote: Growth in the Hearing Instruments segment was supported by the successful launch of the Phonak Infinio and Sphere Infinio platforms

stories.story_fr: Croissance forte des ventes et du EBITA normalisé au premier semestre 2025/26.
stories.story_en: Strong sales and normalized EBITA growth in the first half of 2025/26.
stories.quote: Group sales reached CHF 1,815.4 million, up 4.9%... normalized EBITA rose by 16.0%... margin increase of 1.8 percentage points

stories.story_fr: Mise en place de changements organisationnels pour les activités Hearing Instruments et Audiological Care.
stories.story_en: Implementation of organizational changes for Hearing Instruments and Audiological Care businesses.
stories.quote: Sonova also announces it has initiated organizational changes for its Hearing Instruments and Audiological Care business structures starting November 17, 2025.
